MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 14

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 15
   C. 7
   D. 13

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 12

4. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 48
   C. 2
   D. 14

5. Solve for x: x + 4 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 10
   C. 9
   D. 4

6. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

7. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

8. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 9

9. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 64

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 90

11. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

12. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 156

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — 49
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 7² = 7 × 7
3. 7² = 49
Final Answer: 49
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. D — 13
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 5² + 12²
3. c² = 25 + 144
4. c² = 169
5. c = 13
Final Answer: 13 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

3. C — 36
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 6 × 6
3. Area = 36
Final Answer: 36 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

4. B — 48
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Product = first factor × second factor
2. Substitute values: Product = 8 × 6
3. Product = 48
Final Answer: 48

Working:

Final Answer: x = 9
